summary: Birkenstock Holding plc filed a Form 6-K on June 16, 2026, announcing the pricing of a €900M 4.500% Senior Notes due 2033 issued by an indirect subsidiary. The filing updates the company's Annual Report on Form 20-F with risk factors and business disclosures. This is a routine debt offering and disclosure update, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special event is involved. The registrant is the issuer of notes. The filing is incorporated by reference into existing registration statements. There are no deal terms applicable to a special situation.
